meeting.name: Gowran Park
meeting.going: Hurdle: good to yielding; chase: good

races.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Beginners Chase
races.verdict: Runner-up in a Grade 2 novice hurdle at Cheltenham last year, SIXANDAHALF couldn't make the most of a good opportunity sent chasing at Sligo on her return, but with that outing behind her she is fancied to do much better this time round. The biggest threat could come from Miss Fourie , who looked set to win last time before nearly unseating late on. SIXANDAHALF (IRE) MISS FOURIE (IRE) MO GHILLE MAR (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Sixandahalf (8/15), Miss Fourie (2/1), Mo Ghille Mar (10/1), Cruisin Susan (66/1)

races.title: Gerry Comerford Drilling Beginners Chase
races.verdict: This could go to one of the chasing debutants, with PRINCESS AVEEN preferred after showing sound form in points and winning over hurdles at Fairyhouse in October. Clody Diamond is open to improvement on her second start in this discipline so is on the shortlist along with Market Ready . PRINCESS AVEEN (IRE) CLODY DIAMOND (IRE) MARKET READY (IRE)

races.title: Noreside Catering Handicap Chase
races.verdict: Making her handicap chase debut, BREAK MY SOUL produced her best effort over fences when third in the Grand Annual at Cheltenham and, with a good record fresh, she is taken to add to her C&D victory a year ago. Golden Joy was a good second at Leopardstown in February and is feared most for his new yard. BREAK MY SOUL (IRE) GOLDEN JOY (FR) LEAVE IN SECRET (IRE)

races.title: PRL Group Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: BRADY HARTSFIELD and Huntin Boots stand out on bumper form. John McConnell's charge is preferred given the antics of the latter on his hurdling debut, while Loadstone could be the pick of the Joseph O'Brien newcomers. Baila Conmigo and Rocky Alfonso complete the shortlist. BRADY HARTSFIELD (IRE) HUNTIN BOOTS (IRE) LOADSTONE (IRE)

races.title: Proficient Engineering Irish EBF Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: RECKLESS is likely the one to beat if reproducing his Fairyhouse effort on return. Hurdling debutant Got The Honours has some solid-looking point form, and he rates as the main danger. RECKLESS (FR) GOT THE HONOURS (IRE) LYRICAL PARK (IRE)

races.title: GAIN Equine Nutrition Novice Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: KOME DANS UN REVE has found some progression on his last 2 starts, staying on well to open his account at Limerick, and with the run of this race promising to suit he can score again now that he's up and running. Firebrand arrives on the back of a career best effort and is next on the list, ahead of Papagei . KOME DANS UN REVE (FR) FIREBRAND (GER) PAPAGEI

races.title: Pat Carroll's Pub Kilkenny Mares Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
races.verdict: Not as competitive as the numbers suggest and it could pay to side with KATE KNOWS BEST who should strip sharper for her recent Sligo fifth after an absence and can now capitalise on a handy-looking mark. A Snow White Park completed a hat-trick over fences at Clonmel two days ago and rates a major threat if translating that form back to hurdles. In-form maiden Demanding Gerry and the lightly-raced Lady Fromentro appeal as the pick of the rest. KATE KNOWS BEST (IRE) A SNOW WHITE PARK (IRE) DEMANDING GERRY (IRE)
